messages:
ops-alert-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: chi1-dedicated-pool-7 GPU utilization 98% for 6m, queue depth 3.2k, p95 token latency 2.8s. Auto-fallback threshold breached.

maria: seeing it, joining. impact: some PLG customers hitting 503s?

aj: confirmed multiple 503s from the dedicated pool healthcheck. Low-priority namespaces are queuing. Can we push dev+non-paid traffic to hosted?

sam: +1. We should be selective — avoid shifting high-SLA customers. Recommend tag-based shift: org:dev, env:staging, and a fraction of low-priority prod.

lee: provisioning extra nodes would take ~14-20m and still risk throttles once they boot. I'd prefer immediate spill to hosted for short term while we scale.

maria: agree. plan: 1) shift 65% of low-priority traffic to hosted, 2) open temporary quota guard for hosted cost, 3) start scaling dedicated pool. anyone object?

aj: no objections. I'll run the routing change and add canary checks.

aj: running command now:

```
infractl route update --region chi1 --selector "priority:low,tag:dev|staging" --shift-to hosted --weight 0.65 --reason "spillover chi1 pool7 saturation"
```

sam: watching metrics. tagging note: make sure request headers preserve org-id so hosted can bill correctly.

deploy-bot: rollout started for routing change job job-8842 (eta ~30s).

lee: also enabling queue-short-circuit on pool7 so we stop accumulating long queues while we scale: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap pool7-queue --patch '{"data":{"max_queue_ms":"2000"}}'
```

maria: good. add a cost watch: create a billing alert for hosted spend > $3k/hr for chi1 spill. sam, can you own?

sam: ack. I set a pager on escalation 2 if threshold hit.

aj: canary checks: 1) p95 latency on hosted < 2s for shifted traffic, 2) error-rate < 1%. If fails, automatic rollback will route back to dedicated (risking queued drop).

maria: noted. start dedicated scale too — lee, request +4 gpus to pool7, preemptible if needed. keep autoscaler on.

lee: scale request submitted to cluster mgr. ETA for GPUs reporting ready ~16m.

ops-alert-bot: UPDATE: routing change completed, 65% of matched traffic shifted. Hosted ingress saw a +12% global token rate.

sam: initial canary looks OK: error-rate 0.4%, p95 1.6s for shifted groups. cost projection for next hour ~ $1.7k additional if sustained.

maria: good. keep monitoring. when pool7 new GPUs come online we'll re-evaluate reversing shift gradually. leave fallback policy enabled in case of flapping.

aj: filing short incident note: chi1-dedicated-pool7 saturation -> hosted spillover. Actions: routing shift, queue-short-circuit, scale request. owners: aj (routing), lee (scale), sam (billing watch), maria (incident lead).

maria: thanks all. continuing to monitor, will update if we see new churn. :white_check_mark:
